LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_Intro: Builds a starter supply palette at once - everyday supply, a medic kit, a backpack, combat drugs, a shield. Every item stays editable afterwards: click it to change what it is, edit the count, or drop it. Re-running this later refines a same-named pack in place instead of duplicating it.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_RecommendedTip: Resets every slider to its default (Balanced).
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_DetailedTip: Detailed mode - every slider is shown for hand-tuning.\n\nClick to switch to Simple (presets only).
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_SimpleTip: Simple mode - presets only, the sliders are hidden.\n\nClick to switch to Detailed and hand-tune every slider.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_UseAnyTypesTip: When checked, Medicine/Food/Drugs always pick CE's generic placeholder ("Any Medicine", "Any Perishable Meal", "Any Drug") instead of one concrete item - whatever's in stock counts, nothing to run out of.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_CostTip: Which specific item each category picks when several qualify - cheap/affordable vs. the best regardless of cost. No effect while "Any X" is checked.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_WeightTip: How much of each supply a pack carries, and whether the Shield Kit's shield favours mobility or maximum protection.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_CoverageTip: How many of the templates below default to checked, most essential first (Base Supply, Medic Kit, Shield Kit, Spotter, Tactical Kit, EMP Kit, Combat Drugs Kit last - a deliberate situational choice, never a default). Only affects a row you haven't ticked/unticked yourself.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_BackTip: Back to the previous step of the Arm-my-Colony flow. Steps that already applied are not undone.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_DeleteExisting: Remove every existing Equipment Pack (colonists lose it from their loadout). Every template above then proposes a fresh pack as new.
Delete all {0} equipment pack? This cannot be undone.
Delete all {0} equipment packs? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_SkipTip: Skip this step - nothing is generated here, the Arm-my-Colony flow continues to the next step.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_NameCollisionS: Skipped (name already used by a hand-built pack, not generated by this wizard): {0}
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_ProtectedTip: "{0}" already exists - left as-is by default (Filling gaps). Click to include it in this run, or just edit anything below - any change here applies immediately and includes it too.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_MaterialTipWit: Material this will be crafted from: {0}. Click to change.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_MaterialTipNoS: Material this will be crafted from. Click to change.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_ChangeItemTip: Click to change what this is.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_KeptItemTip: This item was already in the pack and the wizard has no alternatives to offer for it, so it cannot be swapped - it is kept as it is. Use the X to remove it.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_AddItemTip: Add another item to this pack.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_StatePinnedTip: {0} stays exactly as it is. Click to mark it for deletion.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_StateWillCreat: {0} will be created when you apply. Click to leave it out.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_StateWontCreat: {0} will NOT be created. Click to include it.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_StateDeleteTip: {0} will be DELETED when you apply. Click to keep it instead.
LanguageData.CER_GenerateEquipmentPack_StateEditedTip: You changed {0} - your version is written when you apply. Click to mark it for deletion instead.
